study type: Analysis of a subset of findings from the 2016 National Maternal and Newborn Health Quality of Care Assessment
outcome: Quality of health facility documentation related to maternal deaths
cohort: Maternal deaths at health facilities in Afghanistan
finding: Significant gaps exist in the quality of record-keeping related to maternal deaths in Afghanistan, including underreporting, misclassification, and incomplete data.
mod_finding: Information regarding mode of birth was missing in over half of the charts.
